title: Repeated String Match II
statement: It asks whether b repeated y times is a substring of a repeated x times, where |a|,|b| ≤ 100 but x, y reach 10^9, so neither string can be built. Both strings are periodic and their alignment repeats every lcm(|a|,|b|) characters, so only that prefix of b^y needs a substring search in copies of a; the earliest match offset s then fits iff s + |b|·y ≤ |a|·x.
